continuity: Jin Wikyung and Wolhwa reached an agreement establishing cooperation between the Jin Family and the Lower District Sect in Shanxi Murim.
The Lower District Sect supplied the initial information about the Heavenly Wind Band and sent the messenger eagle that delivered it quickly.
A single unknown Supreme Peak master annihilated the Heavenly Wind Band near Datong, including hundreds of mounted bandits and a Peak master; Jin Wikyung privately suspects Sword Saint Mae Jonghak.
The Jin Family of Taiyuan is now publicly presenting itself as the hegemon of Shanxi Murim and has opened a three-day grand banquet on New Year's Day.
Jin Taekyung remains absent because he went to have a weapon forged and has sent no word since leaving last year; Jin Mukyung is in seclusion training after receiving enlightenment.
Woo Hwangtae has arrived at the Jin Family's gates seeking an audience and apology concerning Woo Jintae, but the Jin Family has repeatedly refused to meet him.
Baek Museong and the Huashan group have arrived at the banquet gates, where Baek intervened to restrain his junior disciple.
plot: On New Year's Day, Jin Wikyung, Wolhwa, and Wipeng finalized a mutually beneficial alliance after a long negotiation. The Jin Family received a congratulatory letter from Huashan's Sect Leader, expected the Three Plum Blossom Elites and Prince Shangshan, and privately suspected that Sword Saint Mae Jonghak had annihilated the Heavenly Wind Band, though Wikyung concealed that suspicion from Wolhwa.

Wipeng rebuked the absent Jin Taekyung for leaving to have a weapon forged and cutting off communication, while accepting Jin Mukyung's seclusion training as understandable. Jin Wikyung led fifty First Rate martial artists from the family compound, their numbers swelling to three hundred, then opened the gates to begin the three-day grand banquet and announce the Jin Family's rise as Shanxi Murim's hegemon.

The Jin Family's gates drew hundreds of martial artists, merchants, and commoners, along with the heads of the Five Gates of Shanxi. Woo Hwangtae, chief of the Seongun Escort Bureau, had been denied an audience for five days while seeking to address Woo Jintae's humiliation and apology. His anger erupted when a huge Huashan junior accidentally knocked a pill from his hand and insulted him, but Baek Museong intervened before the conflict could become violent.

The Jin Family is holding a three-day grand banquet beginning on New Year's Day, with support from Huashan, the imperial family, and Shanxi Murim.
Jin Wikyung and Wolhwa finalized a cooperative alliance between the Jin Family and the Lower District Sect.
The Heavenly Wind Band was annihilated near Datong by an unknown Supreme Peak master; Jin Wikyung privately suspects Mae Jonghak.
Jin Taekyung is absent while having a weapon forged and has stopped sending news; Jin Mukyung is undergoing seclusion training after enlightenment.
Woo Hwangtae is seeking an audience and apology regarding Woo Jintae after the Jin Family rejected his requests for five days.
Baek Museong and the Huashan group are present at the Jin Family's gates.
Jang Taebo is forging Taekyung's commissioned weapon.
